votes.motion: Commissioner Fowler moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes for June 22, 2023

Commissioner Ogden moved to APPROVE Home Occupation Conditional Use Permit as requested by Jennifer Stratton for Application USE-055-2023 subject to the following: Conditions of Approval: 1. That all business requirements of the Draper City Engineering, Public Works Building, Business Licensing, Planning, and Fire Divisions are satisfied throughout the operation of the business. 2. A Business License shall be maintained for the life of the business. 3. Customers are not allowed to come to the property
Commissioner Fowler moved to ADJOURN. Vote: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission. The meeting adjourned at 6:36 PM
